name: Asta

ASTA_TOKEN.description: Optional Asta API token for the asta CLI and skills; leave blank and run `asta auth login` instead.

postCreateCommand: npx --yes skills@latest add /opt/asta-plugins --all -g --yes && if [ "$CODESPACES" = true ]; then mkdir -p /workspaces/.asta-auth ~/.config && chmod 700 /workspaces/.asta-auth && ln -sfn /workspaces/.asta-auth ~/.config/asta-cli; fi

postAttachCommand.preview: curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:4848/ || { [ -f Makefile ] && make preview; } || { [ -f _quarto.yml ] && quarto preview --no-browser; } || true
